html:
Causes and Non-profits We Support

Girls Who Code

It is no secret that the gender imbalance in the tech industry is stark. Having founded by a female co-founder, Appstle is keen on supporting organizations that work towards closing the gender employment difference in computing and technology.

Khan Academy

Just like gender, Age, Location, and Economic status should not be a constraint in pursuing one’s dreams. Access to learning should be free for all. On that level, Appstle is dedicated to supporting organizations that democratize education.

Unicef Guardian Circle

There are several notable causes in the world. The ones that touched our hearts the most, are causes impacting the most vulnerable of our population – children. Both the founders of Appstle℠ have been UNICEF Guardian Circle members for many years. Additionally, Appstle℠ Solutions has partnered with, and donates 1% of its monthly profits to organizations that support children orphaned by the COVID pandemic.
